settings.hint: Keys and the token are stored only in your user profile on this computer. The models folder is shared with Voxprint AI Audiobook Builder.
settings.title: Settings
ui.diag_cancelled: Cancelled. A partial report was saved: {path}
ui.diag_desc: Checks the graphics card, memory and ffmpeg, loads every model of the pipeline and measures speech-synthesis speed with and without FlashAttention / CUDA Graphs. The result is a plain text file on your Desktop. The first run downloads models and can take 10-30 minutes.
ui.diag_download_none: Allow downloading missing models (all models are already on this computer)
ui.file_dialog: Choose a movie or series episode
ui.footer: The report contains no personal files; tokens and your Windows user name are hidden. Nothing is sent anywhere - you send the file yourself.
ui.footer_main: Everything runs on this computer. Projects are kept, so an interrupted dub continues where it stopped.
ui.tagline: Adds a dubbed audio track to a movie. The video is not re-encoded and the original audio track stays.
voice.clone: Clone the voice from the film
